items.title: 6.8 Hess ka heat summation ka qanoon (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.8, printed pages 126-130.

blocks.text: Thermodynamics ka pehla qanoon energy ki baqa (conservation of energy) ke qanoon ka izhar hai: energy na banayi ja sakti hai na mitayi, magar ek shakal se doosri mein badli ja sakti hai. Germain Henri Hess ne ise enthalpy tabdeeliyon par lagaya. Bohat si reactions ki enthalpy tabdeeliyan calorimetry se seedhe nahi napi ja saktin, misal ke taur par tetrachloromethane carbon aur chlorine se seedha nahi banaya ja sakta; Hess ka qanoon aisi enthalpy tabdeeliyan nikalne deta hai.

blocks.title: Hess ka qanoon
blocks.text: Kimiyai reaction mein kul enthalpy tabdeeli us raste se azad hai jis se reaction hoti hai, basharte ibtidai aur aakhri halaat ek jaise hon.

Hess ka qanoon enthalpy cycles se dikhaya jata hai, jinhen energy cycles ya Hess cycles bhi kehte hain. Farz karein A seedhe ek qadam mein B banta hai, direct route, ya do ya teen qadmon ke silsile mein, indirect routes 1 aur 2; raste mein banne wale products (M, N aur X, Y, Z) reaction intermediates hain. Phir route 1 ke liye delta Hr = delta H1 + delta H2, aur route 2 ke liye delta Hr = delta H3 + delta H4 + delta H5.

blocks.alt: Baen: dabbe A aur B surkh seedhe teer se aur M + N aur X phir Y + Z se guzarne wale do indirect routes se jure, neeche routes ke muadle aur carbon monoxide ki misal. Daen: reactants, gaseous atoms aur products ke dabbe tikon mein, teer jama toote bonds ki energies aur manfi bane bonds ki energies label-shuda, HCl aur pani ki hal shuda misalon ke saath.
blocks.caption: A se B reaction aur bond energies ke liye Hess cycles (Figure 6.4, chhape hue bond-energy cycle aur Sample Problems 6.1, 6.3 aur 6.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: A se B tak jo bhi rasta liya jaye, us ke saath enthalpy tabdeeliyan usi delta Hr tak jama hoti hain, kyunke energy mehfooz hai. Carbon monoxide ki seedhi formation napi nahi ja sakti, magar carbon ka combustion (-393.5) manfi CO ka combustion (-283) -110.5 kJ fi mol deta hai. Gas reactions ke liye khas cycle azad atoms se guzarta hai: har reactant bond torein (bond energies jama karein) aur har product bond banayein (unhen manfi karein), to H2 + Cl2 se 2HCl 678 - 862 = -184 kJ hai, ya HCl ke fi mole -92 kJ.

blocks.title: Print ki jaanch
blocks.text: Sample 6.6 propane ki term 'delta Hc (C3H8)' likhta hai jahan enthalpy of formation murad hai, aur Sample 6.7 durust 678 istemal karne se pehle '436 + 242 = 478' chhapta hai. Quick Check 6.4 'methane' poochta hai magar benzene ka muadla deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Combustion enthalpies -394 (C), -286 (H2) aur -3267 (C6H6) kJ fi mol se benzene ki standard enthalpy of formation, 6C(s) + 3H2(g) se C6H6(l), nikalein. Phir bond energies (N triple N 945, H-H 436, N-H 391) se N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3 ke liye delta H nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Benzene: delta Hf = 6(-394) + 3(-286) - (-3267) = -2364 - 858 + 3267 = +45 kJ fi mol, endothermic. Ammonia: torna 945 + 3 x 436 = 2253; banna 6 x 391 = 2346; delta H = 2253 - 2346 = -93 kJ fi mol muadla.

items: Hess ka qanoon (pehle qanoon se): kul enthalpy tabdeeli ek hi ibtidai aur aakhri halaton ke darmiyan raste se azad hai; Hess cycle mein kisi bhi indirect route ke qadam delta Hr tak jama hote hain.

Istemal: combustion data se formation (CO -110.5), formation data se reaction (C2H5Cl -68.9), napi hui hararat se formation (propane -104), aur azad atoms se bond energies se reaction (HCl -92 kJ fi mol).
